name: OpenCode
description: Runs Khadim chats through an OpenCode server harness.
author: Khadim contributors

config.label: Binary path
config.description: OpenCode executable used when Server URL is blank.

config.label: Server URL
config.description: Leave blank to let Khadim start a local OpenCode server when needed.

config.label: Username
config.description: HTTP Basic Auth username. OpenCode defaults to opencode.

config.label: Server password
config.description: The OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD value, when authentication is enabled.

config.label: OpenCode agent
config.description: Optional OpenCode agent name, such as build or plan.

config.label: OpenCode provider ID
config.description: Optional provider override configured in OpenCode.

config.label: OpenCode model ID
config.description: Optional model override configured in OpenCode.

config.label: Use Khadim model IDs
config.description: Send the selected Khadim provider and model IDs when no OpenCode override is set.
